title: silencer-protocol note — Family V remediation banked in the silencing detectors
intent: The session meta-finding: removing a silencing mechanism exposes a real bug underneath it (bare-except->leggauss, broken-CI-path->deleted-retopo, trusted-diff->zod). Not a detector — a protocol. Bank the one-line Family V note in the fix-hint of the silencing detectors so the next person sees it: remove the silencer AND fix what surfaces, not just remove the silencer. The 4th and final item from the MAINT-DEFER triage.

scope.out_of_scope_notes: No new analyzer, no detection-logic change — a remediation note appended to the fix-hint. hollow_guarantee (1.0.2) and maxfail_masking (2.0.1) carry it in finding OUTPUT (dedicated silencer detectors, not in the golden analyzer set, so no golden-fixture drift). exceptions carries it at its MODULE DOCSTRING, NOT in finding output: its swallow message is pinned by the signal_logic golden fixtures, and putting a cosmetic note there would force a signal_logic_version bump cascading to 19 fixtures + ~10 manifests — semantically wrong, since no signal-computation logic changed. The docstring is stripped from the AST logic-hash, so exceptions' logic_hash and version are unchanged and no fixture drifts. baselines/main.json untouched (zero structural debt).

what_changed: hollow_guarantee 1.0.1 -> 1.0.2: appended the Family V silencer note to the finding message.
maxfail_masking 2.0.0 -> 2.0.1: appended the Family V silencer note to the LOW (no-collect-all-escape) finding message.

exceptions: added the Family V protocol to the module docstring (source-level banking). Message and version (1.1.0) unchanged, so no golden-fixture drift and no signal_logic_version bump — a cosmetic remediation note is not a signal-logic change.
Two regression tests assert the note is present in a hollow_guarantee and a maxfail_masking finding. Logic manifest refreshed (only hollow_guarantee + maxfail_masking logic_hash/version change).
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The note is a protocol, not a detector; it belongs where a person acting on a silencer finding will read it. Placed to be visible without misrepresenting the signal-logic contract.

test_results: hollow_guarantee + maxfail_masking + exceptions: all passed (incl. 2 new note-assertion tests).
golden fixtures + signal-logic-bump gates: all passed — exceptions output unchanged, no golden drift, no signal_logic_version bump.
verification.notes: The 4th and final branch of the MAINT-DEFER triage. Detectors A/B/C shipped; each its own branch, held for triage.
